name: partyshare
description: Screen sharing and voice rooms for small groups

dependencies.name: libdatachannel
dependencies.$comment: srtp is what builds the media transport. Without it rtc/rtp.hpp is absent and the SFU, which forwards RTP, does not compile. The port ships only ws by default.

$comment: Qt 6 is installed through the platform SDK, not through vcpkg. libdatachannel provides both the signaling WebSocket (M2) and the SFU (M4).

mongo.description: MongoDB persistence for the server: accounts, roles, rooms and the audit log
